desc:
Premium players receive a 10% EXP bonus.
--------------------

💪Train to get powerful 
📝Do quests to earn money, rewards and improve your skills 
⬆️Unlock new techniques and transformations and master them to surpass your limits 
⚔️Fight bosses to earn Zeni and other rewards 
💸Use your money to buy items in the shop 
🔥Break the barriers by obtaining divine powers 
🌌Participate in the Tournament of Power and show who is the strongest in the universe 

--------------------

Keybinds: 
Left Click - Punch 
C - Charge Ki 
Q - Dash
E - Ki Blast 
Y - Meditate 
B - Supress Aura 
M - Menu
